description:
What is This Part?
This is the Suzuki OEM rubber cover that goes over the metal foot plate on the Accelerator, clutch and brake pedals
Suzuki OEM Part
Direct Replacement
What Will I Receive?
Qty 1 – Cover, Clutch
Qty 1 – Cover, Brake
Qty 1 – Cover, Accelerator
What Vehicle Will This Fit?
Suzuki Samurai 1985 – 1995 All Models
Suzuki SJ410 1980 – 1984 All Models
